newsitem.title: ITALY: Five confirmed dead in plane crash in Italy.
newsitem.headline: Five confirmed dead in plane crash in Italy.

text.p: Five people including the pilot were killed when an Antonov cargo plane crashed while attempting to land at Turin airport in northwest Italy, an official at the local prefecture said.
The official said 12 others were injured in the crash which happened as the Antonov 124 came in to land on a flight from Moscow.
Another three people on the ground were feared dead, buried by rubble as the plane ploughed through buildings before coming to rest less than half a mile (a km) from Turin's Caselle airport.
Initial reports said 22 people had been killed in the crash.
The plane struck two houses before smashing into a farm building and coming to a halt on a road close to a cemetery in the village of San Francesco del Campo.
A Reuter correspondent at the Di Cirie hospital close to the scene said 10 injured had been brought in, including two crew members and two villagers.
